data.title: Amazon Threat Intelligence observes threat actors running cybercrime campaigns with ARTEX AI agents | Amazon Web Services
data.description: From Oct. 3 to Nov. 5, 2026, Amazon’s MadPot, a globally distributed network of decoy threat sensors, captured requests from AI agents that included operating memory from offensive campaigns that threat actors ran on ARTEX, an open-source agentic AI penetration testing framework. The ARTEX agents sent these requests to MadPot sensors configured to present as […]
